variables.$fxv#0:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail
umask 077

GHES_HOSTNAME="${GHES_HOSTNAME:-}"
GHES_MGMT_PASSWORD="${GHES_MGMT_PASSWORD:-}"
GHES_KEYVAULT_URI="${GHES_KEYVAULT_URI:-}"
GHES_LICENSE_PART1_SECRET_NAME="${GHES_LICENSE_PART1_SECRET_NAME:-}"
GHES_LICENSE_PART2_SECRET_NAME="${GHES_LICENSE_PART2_SECRET_NAME:-}"

GHES_SUBDOMAIN_ISOLATION="${GHES_SUBDOMAIN_ISOLATION:-true}"
GHES_SIGNUP_ENABLED="${GHES_SIGNUP_ENABLED:-false}"
GHES_PUBLIC_PAGES="${GHES_PUBLIC_PAGES:-false}"

GHES_MANAGE_PORT="${GHES_MANAGE_PORT:-8443}"
GHES_APPLY_TIMEOUT_MIN="${GHES_APPLY_TIMEOUT_MIN:-120}"
GHES_READY_TIMEOUT_MIN="${GHES_READY_TIMEOUT_MIN:-30}"

GHES_SKIP_APPLY="${GHES_SKIP_APPLY:-false}"
GHES_VERIFY="${GHES_VERIFY:-true}"
GHES_VERIFY_STRICT="${GHES_VERIFY_STRICT:-false}"

LIC_FILE="$(mktemp /tmp/ghes-license.XXXXXX.ghl)"
PW_FILE="$(mktemp /tmp/ghes-pw.XXXXXX)"
INIT_OUT="$(mktemp /tmp/ghes-init.XXXXXX.out)"
LEGACY_INIT_OUT="$(mktemp /tmp/ghes-legacy-init.XXXXXX.out)"
SETTINGS_OUT="$(mktemp /tmp/ghes-settings.XXXXXX.out)"
HIMDS_HEADERS="$(mktemp /tmp/ghes-himds-headers.XXXXXX.out)"
TOKEN_OUT="$(mktemp /tmp/ghes-token.XXXXXX.json)"
SECRET1_OUT="$(mktemp /tmp/ghes-secret1.XXXXXX.json)"
SECRET2_OUT="$(mktemp /tmp/ghes-secret2.XXXXXX.json)"

HIMDS_ENDPOINT="http://127.0.0.1:40342/metadata/identity/oauth2/token"
KEYVAULT_RESOURCE="https://vault.azure.net"
HIMDS_API_VERSION="2020-06-01"
KEYVAULT_API_VERSION="7.4"
ACCESS_TOKEN=""
HIMDS_CHALLENGE=""
LICENSE_PART1=""
LICENSE_PART2=""

log() {
    printf '%s [post-config] %s\n' \
        "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$*"
}

secure_remove() {
    local path="$1"

    if command -v shred >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        shred -u "$path" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$path"
    else
        rm -f "$path"
    fi
}

cleanup() {
    secure_remove "$LIC_FILE"
    secure_remove "$PW_FILE"
    secure_remove "$INIT_OUT"
    secure_remove "$LEGACY_INIT_OUT"
    secure_remove "$SETTINGS_OUT"
    secure_remove "$HIMDS_HEADERS"
    secure_remove "$TOKEN_OUT"
    secure_remove "$SECRET1_OUT"
    secure_remove "$SECRET2_OUT"
    unset ACCESS_TOKEN HIMDS_CHALLENGE LICENSE_PART1 LICENSE_PART2
}

die() {
    log "ERROR: $*"
    cleanup
    exit 1
}

trap cleanup EXIT

lc() {
    printf '%s' "$1" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'
}

response_diagnostic() {
    local path="$1"

    [[ -s "$path" ]] || {
        printf '%s' '<empty>'
        return
    }

    awk -v password_file="$PW_FILE" '
        BEGIN {
            if ((getline password < password_file) < 0) {
                password = ""
            }
            close(password_file)
            limit = 1000
            emitted = 0
        }

        function redact_literal(text, secret, replacement, pos) {
            if (secret == "") {
                return text
            }

            while ((pos = index(text, secret)) > 0) {
                text = substr(text, 1, pos - 1) replacement substr(text, pos + length(secret))
            }

            return text
        }

        function redact_url_queries(text, output, token, query_pos) {
            output = ""

            while (match(text, /https?:\/\/[^[:space:]"]+\?[^[:space:]"]*/)) {
                token = substr(text, RSTART, RLENGTH)
                query_pos = index(token, "?")
                output = output substr(text, 1, RSTART - 1) \
                    substr(token, 1, query_pos) "[REDACTED]"
                text = substr(text, RSTART + RLENGTH)
            }

            return output text
        }

        function redact_sensitive_json_values(text, output, lower, prefix, rest, quote_pos) {
            output = ""
            lower = tolower(text)

            while (match(lower, /"(password|license|license_uri|license_url|sas|token)"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"/)) {
                prefix = substr(text, 1, RSTART + RLENGTH - 1)
                rest = substr(text, RSTART + RLENGTH)
                quote_pos = index(rest, "\"")

                if (quote_pos == 0) {
                    output = output prefix "[REDACTED]"
                    text = ""
                } else {
                    output = output prefix "[REDACTED]\""
                    text = substr(rest, quote_pos + 1)
                }

                lower = tolower(text)
            }

            return output text
        }

        {
            line = $0
            gsub(/[[:cntrl:]]/, " ", line)
            line = redact_literal(line, password, "[REDACTED]")
            line = redact_url_queries(line)
            line = redact_sensitive_json_values(line)
            line = line " "

            remaining = limit - emitted
            if (remaining > 0) {
                printf "%s", substr(line, 1, remaining)
                emitted += length(substr(line, 1, remaining))
            }

            if (emitted >= limit) {
                exit
            }
        }
    ' "$path"
}

already_initialized_response() {
    local path="$1"

    grep -qiE \
        '(already[[:space:]]+(been[[:space:]]+)?initialized|initialization[[:space:]]+already[[:space:]]+(complete|completed)|password[^[:cntrl:]]{0,80}already[[:space:]]+(been[[:space:]]+)?set)' \
        "$path" 2>/dev/null
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Prerequisite validation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

[[ "${EUID:-$(id -u)}" -eq 0 ]] ||
    die "must run as root (Arc Linux Run Command runs as root by default)."

command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
    die "curl not found on the appliance."

command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
    die "python3 not found on the appliance; it is required for safe JSON parsing and URL validation."

command -v ghe-config-apply >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
    die "ghe-config-apply not found - this does not look like a GHES appliance."

[[ -n "$GHES_HOSTNAME" ]] ||
    die "GHES_HOSTNAME is required."

[[ -n "$GHES_MGMT_PASSWORD" ]] ||
    die "GHES_MGMT_PASSWORD is required (protected parameter)."

[[ -n "$GHES_KEYVAULT_URI" ]] ||
    die "GHES_KEYVAULT_URI is required."

[[ -n "$GHES_LICENSE_PART1_SECRET_NAME" ]] ||
    die "GHES_LICENSE_PART1_SECRET_NAME is required."

[[ -n "$GHES_LICENSE_PART2_SECRET_NAME" ]] ||
    die "GHES_LICENSE_PART2_SECRET_NAME is required."

python3 - "$GHES_KEYVAULT_URI" "$GHES_LICENSE_PART1_SECRET_NAME" "$GHES_LICENSE_PART2_SECRET_NAME" <<'PY' ||
import re
import sys
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

vault_uri, *secret_names = sys.argv[1:]
parsed = urlsplit(vault_uri)
try:
    port = parsed.port
except ValueError:
    raise SystemExit(1)
if (
    parsed.scheme != "https"
    or not parsed.hostname
    or not parsed.hostname.endswith(".vault.azure.net")
    or parsed.username
    or parsed.password
    or port not in (None, 443)
    or parsed.path not in ("", "/")
    or parsed.query
    or parsed.fragment
):
    raise SystemExit(1)
if any(not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9A-Za-z-]{1,127}", name) for name in secret_names):
    raise SystemExit(1)
PY
    die "Key Vault URI or secret name is invalid."

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Normalize settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

SUBDOM="$(lc "$GHES_SUBDOMAIN_ISOLATION")"
[[ "$SUBDOM" == "true" || "$SUBDOM" == "false" ]] || SUBDOM="true"

SIGNUP="$(lc "$GHES_SIGNUP_ENABLED")"
[[ "$SIGNUP" == "true" || "$SIGNUP" == "false" ]] || SIGNUP="false"

PUBPAGES="$(lc "$GHES_PUBLIC_PAGES")"
[[ "$PUBPAGES" == "true" || "$PUBPAGES" == "false" ]] || PUBPAGES="false"

PORT="$GHES_MANAGE_PORT"
BASE="https://127.0.0.1:${PORT}"

log "hostname=${GHES_HOSTNAME} port=${PORT} subdomain_isolation=${SUBDOM} signup_enabled=${SIGNUP} public_pages=${PUBPAGES}"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Retrieve and reconstruct GHES license
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

get_json_string() {
    local path="$1"
    local field="$2"

    python3 - "$path" "$field" <<'PY'
import json
import sys

path, field = sys.argv[1:]
try:
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        payload = json.load(handle)
    value = payload[field]
except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, TypeError):
    raise SystemExit(1)
if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
    raise SystemExit(1)
sys.stdout.write(value)
PY
}

urlencode_path_segment() {
    python3 - "$1" <<'PY'
import sys
from urllib.parse import quote

sys.stdout.write(quote(sys.argv[1], safe=""))
PY
}

himds_status=$(
    curl \
        -sS \
        -D "$HIMDS_HEADERS" \
        -o /dev/null \
        -w '%{http_code}' \
        --connect-timeout 5 \
        --max-time 15 \
        -H 'Metadata: true' \
        --get \
        --data-urlencode "api-version=${HIMDS_API_VERSION}" \
        --data-urlencode "resource=${KEYVAULT_RESOURCE}" \
        "$HIMDS_ENDPOINT" \
        2>/dev/null ||
        echo 000
)
himds_status="${himds_status: -3}"
[[ "$himds_status" == "401" ]] ||
    die "Arc HIMDS challenge request failed (HTTP ${himds_status})."

challenge_file=$(
    python3 - "$HIMDS_HEADERS" <<'PY'
import re
import sys

try:
    with open(sys.argv[1], "r", encoding="iso-8859-1") as handle:
        headers = handle.read().splitlines()
except OSError:
    raise SystemExit(1)

for header in headers:
    match = re.match(r"(?i)^www-authenticate:\s*Basic\s+realm=(?:\"([^\"]+)\"|(\S+))\s*$", header)
    if match:
        sys.stdout.write(match.group(1) or match.group(2))
        break
else:
    raise SystemExit(1)
PY
) || die "Arc HIMDS challenge response was missing the challenge-file path."

[[ "$challenge_file" == /* && -f "$challenge_file" && ! -L "$challenge_file" ]] ||
    die "Arc HIMDS returned an invalid challenge-file path."

challenge_owner=$(stat -c '%U' "$challenge_file" 2>/dev/null) ||
    die "could not inspect the Arc HIMDS challenge file."
challenge_group=$(stat -c '%G' "$challenge_file" 2>/dev/null) ||
    die "could not inspect the Arc HIMDS challenge file."
challenge_mode=$(stat -c '%a' "$challenge_file" 2>/dev/null) ||
    die "could not inspect the Arc HIMDS challenge file permissions."
[[ "$challenge_mode" =~ ^[0-7]{3,4}$ ]] ||
    die "Arc HIMDS challenge file permissions or ownership are unsafe."
challenge_mode_value=$((8#$challenge_mode))
case "${challenge_owner}:${challenge_group}" in
    root:root|root:himds|himds:himds)
        ;;
    *)
        die "Arc HIMDS challenge file permissions or ownership are unsafe."
        ;;
esac
[[ -r "$challenge_file" ]] ||
    die "Arc HIMDS challenge file permissions or ownership are unsafe."
(( (challenge_mode_value & 0007) == 0 && (challenge_mode_value & 0030) == 0 )) ||
    die "Arc HIMDS challenge file permissions or ownership are unsafe."

HIMDS_CHALLENGE=$(<"$challenge_file") ||
    die "could not read the Arc HIMDS challenge file."
[[ -n "$HIMDS_CHALLENGE" ]] ||
    die "Arc HIMDS challenge file was empty."

himds_status=$(
    curl \
        -sS \
        -o "$TOKEN_OUT" \
        -w '%{http_code}' \
        --connect-timeout 5 \
        --max-time 30 \
        -H 'Metadata: true' \
        -H "Authorization: Basic ${HIMDS_CHALLENGE}" \
        --get \
        --data-urlencode "api-version=${HIMDS_API_VERSION}" \
        --data-urlencode "resource=${KEYVAULT_RESOURCE}" \
        "$HIMDS_ENDPOINT" \
        2>/dev/null ||
        echo 000
)
himds_status="${himds_status: -3}"
unset HIMDS_CHALLENGE challenge_file challenge_owner challenge_group challenge_mode challenge_mode_value
[[ "$himds_status" == "200" ]] ||
    die "Arc HIMDS token request failed (HTTP ${himds_status})."

ACCESS_TOKEN=$(get_json_string "$TOKEN_OUT" access_token) ||
    die "Arc HIMDS token response was invalid."
secure_remove "$TOKEN_OUT"

fetch_keyvault_secret() {
    local secret_name="$1"
    local output_path="$2"
    local encoded_name
    local status
    local attempt
    local delay=5
    local max_attempts=6

    encoded_name=$(urlencode_path_segment "$secret_name") ||
        die "failed to encode a Key Vault secret name."

    for ((attempt = 1; attempt <= max_attempts; attempt++)); do
        : >"$output_path"
        status=$(
            curl \
                -sS \
                -o "$output_path" \
                -w '%{http_code}' \
                --connect-timeout 10 \
                --max-time 60 \
                -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
                --get \
                --data-urlencode "api-version=${KEYVAULT_API_VERSION}" \
                "${GHES_KEYVAULT_URI%/}/secrets/${encoded_name}" \
                2>/dev/null ||
                echo 000
        )
        status="${status: -3}"

        if [[ "$status" == "200" ]]; then
            return 0
        fi

        if [[ "$status" =~ ^(401|403)$ && "$attempt" -lt "$max_attempts" ]]; then
            log "Key Vault authorization is not ready (HTTP ${status}); retrying in ${delay}s (${attempt}/${max_attempts})."
            sleep "$delay"
            delay=$((delay < 40 ? delay * 2 : 60))
            continue
        fi

        die "Key Vault secret retrieval failed (HTTP ${status}, attempt ${attempt}/${max_attempts}); response body suppressed."
    done
}

fetch_keyvault_secret "$GHES_LICENSE_PART1_SECRET_NAME" "$SECRET1_OUT"
fetch_keyvault_secret "$GHES_LICENSE_PART2_SECRET_NAME" "$SECRET2_OUT"

LICENSE_PART1=$(get_json_string "$SECRET1_OUT" value) ||
    die "first Key Vault secret response was invalid."
LICENSE_PART2=$(get_json_string "$SECRET2_OUT" value) ||
    die "second Key Vault secret response was invalid."

secure_remove "$SECRET1_OUT"
secure_remove "$SECRET2_OUT"
unset ACCESS_TOKEN GHES_LICENSE_PART1_SECRET_NAME GHES_LICENSE_PART2_SECRET_NAME

if ! printf '%s%s' "$LICENSE_PART1" "$LICENSE_PART2" | base64 -d > "$LIC_FILE"; then
    die "failed to base64-decode the GHES license."
fi

if [[ ! -s "$LIC_FILE" ]]; then
    die "decoded GHES license file is empty."
fi

chmod 600 "$LIC_FILE"

unset LICENSE_PART1 LICENSE_PART2

printf '%s' "$GHES_MGMT_PASSWORD" >"$PW_FILE"
chmod 600 "$PW_FILE"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authentication helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

auth_config() {
    local esc=${GHES_MGMT_PASSWORD//\\/\\\\}
    esc=${esc//\"/\\\"}

    printf 'user = "api_key:%s"\n' "$esc"
}

manage_api_code() {
    local code

    code=$(
        auth_config |
            curl \
                -K - \
                -k \
                -sS \
                -o /dev/null \
                -w '%{http_code}' \
                --connect-timeout 10 \
                --max-time 30 \
                "${BASE}/manage/v1/config/settings" \
                2>/dev/null ||
            echo 000
    )

    printf '%s' "${code: -3}"
}

apply_in_progress() {
    pgrep -f 'ghe-config-apply' >/dev/null 2>&1
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Initialize GHES
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

init_ghes() {
    local code
    local diagnostic

    code=$(manage_api_code)
    if [[ "$code" == "200" ]]; then
        log "Manage API is already authenticated (HTTP 200); initialization is complete."
        return 0
    fi

    log "initializing via ${BASE}/manage/v1/config/init"

    code=$(
        curl \
            -k \
            -sS \
            -o "$INIT_OUT" \
            -w '%{http_code}' \
            --connect-timeout 15 \
            --max-time 120 \
            -X POST \
            -F "license=@${LIC_FILE}" \
            -F "password=<${PW_FILE}" \
            "${BASE}/manage/v1/config/init" \
            2>/dev/null ||
            echo 000
    )
    code="${code: -3}"

    case "$code" in
        200|201|202)
            log "manage init accepted (HTTP ${code})."
            return 0
            ;;
        400)
            if [[ "$(manage_api_code)" == "200" ]]; then
                log "manage init returned HTTP 400, but authenticated Manage API is now available; initialization is complete."
                return 0
            fi

            if already_initialized_response "$INIT_OUT"; then
                log "manage init reports the instance is already initialized; continuing."
                return 0
            fi
            ;;
    esac

    if [[ ! "$code" =~ ^(404|405|410)$ ]]; then
        diagnostic=$(response_diagnostic "$INIT_OUT")
        log "initialization failed at /manage/v1/config/init (HTTP ${code}); response: ${diagnostic}"
        return 1
    fi

    diagnostic=$(response_diagnostic "$INIT_OUT")
    log "manage init endpoint unavailable (HTTP ${code}); response: ${diagnostic}; trying legacy /setup/api/start."

    code=$(
        curl \
            -k \
            -sS \
            -o "$LEGACY_INIT_OUT" \
            -w '%{http_code}' \
            --connect-timeout 15 \
            --max-time 120 \
            -X POST \
            -F "license=@${LIC_FILE}" \
            -F "password=<${PW_FILE}" \
            "${BASE}/setup/api/start" \
            2>/dev/null ||
            echo 000
    )
    code="${code: -3}"

    case "$code" in
        200|201|202)
            log "legacy init accepted (HTTP ${code})."
            return 0
            ;;
        400)
            if [[ "$(manage_api_code)" == "200" ]]; then
                log "legacy init returned HTTP 400, but authenticated Manage API is now available; initialization is complete."
                return 0
            fi

            if already_initialized_response "$LEGACY_INIT_OUT"; then
                log "legacy init reports the instance is already initialized; continuing."
                return 0
            fi
            ;;
    esac

    diagnostic=$(response_diagnostic "$LEGACY_INIT_OUT")
    log "initialization failed at /setup/api/start (HTTP ${code}); response: ${diagnostic}"
    return 1
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Wait for Manage API
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

wait_ready() {
    local deadline
    local code

    deadline=$(( $(date +%s) + GHES_READY_TIMEOUT_MIN * 60 ))

    log "waiting up to ${GHES_READY_TIMEOUT_MIN}m for Manage API + initial apply to settle."

    while (( $(date +%s) < deadline )); do
        code=$(manage_api_code)

        if [[ "$code" == "200" ]] && ! apply_in_progress; then
            log "Manage API ready (HTTP 200) and no apply in progress."
            return 0
        fi

        log "not ready yet (manage_api=${code}, apply_running=$(apply_in_progress && echo yes || echo no)); retrying in 30s."
        sleep 30
    done

    return 1
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stage GHES settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

stage_settings() {
    local body
    local code

    body=$(
        printf \
            '{"github_hostname":"%s","subdomain_isolation":%s,"signup_enabled":%s,"public_pages":%s}' \
            "$GHES_HOSTNAME" \
            "$SUBDOM" \
            "$SIGNUP" \
            "$PUBPAGES"
    )

    log "staging settings via PUT ${BASE}/manage/v1/config/settings"

    code=$(
        auth_config |
            curl \
                -K - \
                -k \
                -sS \
                -o "$SETTINGS_OUT" \
                -w '%{http_code}' \
                --connect-timeout 15 \
                --max-time 120 \
                -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
                -X PUT \
                --data "$body" \
                "${BASE}/manage/v1/config/settings" \
                2>/dev/null ||
            echo 000
    )

    if [[ "$code" =~ ^2 ]]; then
        log "settings staged (HTTP ${code})."
        return 0
    fi

    die "settings PUT failed (HTTP ${code}); response body suppressed."
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Apply GHES configuration
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

apply_config() {
    local logf
    local rc

    logf="/data/user/common/ghe-config-apply.$(date -u +%Y%m%d%H%M%S).log"

    log "running ghe-config-apply (timeout ${GHES_APPLY_TIMEOUT_MIN}m); log: ${logf}"

    if command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        timeout "${GHES_APPLY_TIMEOUT_MIN}m" \
            ghe-config-apply >"$logf" 2>&1 &&
            rc=0 ||
            rc=$?
    else
        ghe-config-apply >"$logf" 2>&1 &&
            rc=0 ||
            rc=$?
    fi

    log "ghe-config-apply exit code: ${rc}"
    log "--- last 20 lines of apply log ---"

    tail -n 20 "$logf" 2>/dev/null || true

    log "----------------------------------"

    return "$rc"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Verify endpoints
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

verify_endpoints() {
    [[ "$(lc "$GHES_VERIFY")" == "true" ]] || {
        log "endpoint self-verify skipped (GHES_VERIFY=false)."
        return 0
    }

    local failures=0

    check_code() {
        local desc="$1"
        local url="$2"
        local expected="$3"
        local code

        shift 3

        code=$(
            curl \
                -k \
                -sS \
                -o /dev/null \
                -w '%{http_code}' \
                --connect-timeout 10 \
                --max-time 30 \
                "$@" \
                "$url" \
                2>/dev/null ||
                echo 000
        )

        if [[ "$code" =~ ^($expected)$ ]]; then
            log "verify PASS: ${desc} (HTTP ${code})"
        else
            log "verify FAIL: ${desc} (expected ${expected}, got ${code})"
            failures=$((failures + 1))
        fi
    }

    log "verifying appliance endpoints (Host: ${GHES_HOSTNAME})."

    check_code \
        "web root -> redirect to /login" \
        "https://127.0.0.1/" \
        '301|302' \
        -H "Host: ${GHES_HOSTNAME}"

    check_code \
        "login page reachable" \
        "https://127.0.0.1/login" \
        '200' \
        -H "Host: ${GHES_HOSTNAME}"

    check_code \
        "manage API requires auth" \
        "${BASE}/manage/v1/config/apply" \
        '401'

    if (( failures > 0 )); then
        if [[ "$(lc "$GHES_VERIFY_STRICT")" == "true" ]]; then
            die "endpoint self-verify failed (${failures} check(s)) and GHES_VERIFY_STRICT=true."
        fi

        log "WARNING: endpoint self-verify reported ${failures} failure(s) (non-fatal; set GHES_VERIFY_STRICT=true to fail)."
    else
        log "endpoint self-verify: all checks passed."
    fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

init_ghes ||
    die "GHES first-boot initialization failed."

wait_ready ||
    die "GHES Manage API did not become ready within ${GHES_READY_TIMEOUT_MIN}m."

stage_settings

if [[ "$(lc "$GHES_SKIP_APPLY")" == "true" ]]; then
    log "GHES_SKIP_APPLY=true - settings staged but skipping ghe-config-apply."
    log "post-config completed (staged only)."
    exit 0
fi

if apply_config; then
    log "post-config completed successfully."

    verify_endpoints

    log "REMINDER: Active Directory objects, DNS records, and LDAP auth-mode remain MANUAL."
    exit 0
fi

die "ghe-config-apply reported a non-zero exit; see the apply log above."
variables.$fxv#1:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
script_file="$(mktemp)"
cleanup() {
  if command -v shred >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    shred -u "$script_file" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$script_file"
  else
    rm -f "$script_file"
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT
